brief: A kitchen herb planter: three bins on bases, filled with soil and planted with basil, thyme and mint.

requirements.evidence: 3 full hex bases at 0,0,0 / 1,0,0 / 0,1,0 each with hex-bin-full (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full, bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full)
fillSoil on all three bins to rim (soil array shows 3 entries)

finish.summary: Built kitchen herb planter with three adjacent hex bases each holding a full-depth bin, all filled with soil and planted with basil, thyme and mint (harvest-stage plants).
